payload.artist_html: S. N. F. Spiekman, C. Browning, M. Tshibalanganda, D. Mukherjee, R. M. H. Smith, A. Du Plessis & F. Wolvaardt
payload.credit_html: "Micro-CT informed cranial anatomy of the early rhynchosaur Howesia browni, with implications for rhynchosaur skull evolution"
payload.description_html: Howesia browni SAM-PK-K10180. Photographs (A, C) and μCT-derived reconstructions (B, D) in dorsal (A, B) and ventral (C, D) view. Bones are labelled; other relevant morphological structures are marked in bold and underlined. Abbreviations: alp, anterolateral process; amp, anteromedial process; an, angular; ar, articular; dep, depression; ect, ectopterygoid; fib, fibula; fr, frontal; hy, hyoid; j, jugal; l., left; lg, longitudinal groove; mt, metatarsal; mx, maxilla; na, nasal; pa, parietal; pmx, premaxilla; po, postorbital; pof, postfrontal; pra, prearticular; prf, prefrontal; q, quadrate; r, ridge; rpf, rudimentary parietal foramen; sa, surangular; sgc, sagittal crest; spl, splenial; sq, squamosal; tib, tibia; vlf, ventrolateral flange. Scale bar represents 20 mm.
